stories.headline: SPACEX *WINS* APPROVAL FOR SATELLITES
stories.facts: The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy up to one million AI-equipped data center satellites for its new Starmind initiative.
stories.caption_line: 🛰️ SpaceX gets FCC approval to put up to one million AI data center satellites into orbit.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage composition featuring a sleek satellite orbiting a glowing blue Earth in the foreground, with futuristic data center racks glowing in the midground and holographic network lines weaving through space. The lighting is a dramatic cosmic sunset with an electric-blue and warm-orange palette, showing no readable text.
stories.source_title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space

stories.headline: AMAZON AND META *TALK SHOP*
stories.facts: Amazon and Meta are negotiating to end the block on Meta's popular Muse AI shopping agent within Amazon's store.
stories.caption_line: 🛍️ Amazon and Meta are reportedly in talks to lift the blockade on the Muse AI shopping agent.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage composition showing a smartphone displaying a glowing shopping interface in the foreground, with modern fulfillment center shelves and floating transaction charts in the midground. Holographic data streams and orange pricing pins overlay the scene under studio rim lighting with an electric-blue and warm-orange palette, containing no readable text.
stories.source_title: Amazon and Meta are in talks to end the block on Meta's AI shopping agent Muse in Amazon's online store.

stories.headline: STATES *FIGHT* CHAT AUCTION
stories.facts: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is working to stop Character.AI from selling 21 million user chats during bankruptcy.
stories.caption_line: ⚖️ Forty-two state AGs are trying to block Character.AI from auctioning off private user chat histories.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage composition with a classic wooden gavel resting on a sleek glass surface in the foreground, backed by corporate restructuring documents and server racks in the midground. Holographic shield icons and rising legal risk curves fill the air with a dramatic sunset glow and an electric-blue and warm-orange palette, showing no text.
stories.source_title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats

stories.headline: HACKERS *AUTOMATE* CYBERATTACKS
stories.facts: State-backed groups and criminal organizations are utilizing the ARTEX AI framework to run automated cyberattacks with minimal human involvement.
stories.caption_line: 💻 Microsoft details how state-backed hackers use the ARTEX AI framework to automate attacks.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage featuring glowing cybersecurity code streams on a dark terminal screen in the foreground, with server infrastructure and warning nodes in the midground. Holographic firewall layers and pulsing threat vectors illuminate the scene with neon rim light in an electric-blue and warm-orange palette, with no readable text.
stories.source_title: Microsoft details how state-backed hackers use the ARTEX AI framework to automate cyberattacks

stories.headline: NVIDIA *HALTS* SERVER SHIPMENTS
stories.facts: Following new US export controls, Nvidia ordered partners to stop shipping servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia.
stories.caption_line: 🛑 Nvidia halts server shipments to several Southeast Asian countries following tighter US export controls.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage showing stacks of high-performance server hardware inside a massive warehouse in the foreground, with cargo shipping ports and global trade routes in the midground. Holographic trade restriction icons and data flow lines glow under studio lighting with an electric-blue and warm-orange color scheme, containing no text.
stories.source_title: Nvidia halts server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia after tighter US export controls

stories.headline: NEW YORK *BANS* AI TOYS
stories.facts: New York enacted a five-year ban on AI chatbot toys following safety failures and risks highlighted by Common Sense Media research.
stories.caption_line: 🧸 New York bans AI chatbot toys for five years over child safety and emotional development risks.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage featuring a collection of classic children's toys on a shelf in the foreground, with a glowing toy robot and safety testing lab equipment in the midground. Holographic warning seals and compliance checkmarks float above in warm studio lighting with an electric-blue and warm-orange palette, with no text.
stories.source_title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York

stories.headline: OPENAI *TESTS* PRIVATE DATA
stories.facts: OpenAI is testing a Private Inference feature allowing companies to run queries on powerful models without OpenAI accessing the data.
stories.caption_line: 🔒 OpenAI is testing 'Private Inference' to let companies run queries without exposing their data.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage highlighting a glowing digital padlock floating above a high-tech processor chip in the foreground, with secure enterprise data vaults in the midground. Holographic encryption keys and secure data streams overlay the scene with neon rim lighting in an electric-blue and warm-orange palette, showing no text.
stories.source_title: OpenAI wants companies to trust it with sensitive work by promising not to look at their data
